items.title: Private Charter Pickup → Maolin
items.getThere: Private charter from the hotel to Maolin District. The Maolin NSA recommends self-drive or a charter for this mountain area (public buses and Taiwan Tourist Shuttles are limited/reservation-only).
items.hours: Maolin Visitor Center (茂林巷7-7號): 09:00–17:00, tel 07-680-1111.
tips: Ask the driver to fuel up before leaving the plains — the Maolin NSA explicitly advises filling the tank before entering the mountain area.
Butterflies are most active on calm, sunny mornings from first light to about 11 AM, so the 7:15 AM pickup is justified; don't let breakfast delay departure.

sources.label: Maolin NSA – How to get to Maolin

items.title: Maolin Purple Butterfly Valley
items.hours: Ecological park open 24 h; best viewing from first light to about 11 AM on calm, sunny mornings. Season October – end of February.
items.getThere: Park entrance opposite 高雄市茂林區茂林里1鄰16號; park in the Purple Butterfly Ecological Park car park (official advice for the butterfly season).
highlights: Walk the 姿沙里沙里步道 from the park: 2.1 km open section (~50 min), a key overwintering cluster spot; viewing deck over Maolin village, then 瑪雅亭 lookout over the Zhuokou/Laonong river confluence.
Four species overwinter here: 小紫斑蝶, 圓翅紫斑蝶, 斯氏紫斑蝶, 端紫斑蝶 (mnemonic: one dot / two dots / three dots / scattered dots).
Before sun hits the valley, look for 'butterfly trees' — wings closed, hanging in grape-like bunches — then watch them open to sunbathe.
Best case per the NSA: a sunny day right after rain, when swarms glide down the valley to drink ("butterfly carpet").
tips: Check the official daily forecast (蝶況預報) the evening before: it rates butterfly numbers 1–5 stars and names the best trail and window for that day.
Season events run Oct 31 2026 – Mar 31 2027, with interpretation at the ecological park entrance.
Bring sun protection and insect repellent; dress for outdoor walking.
items.watch: Rules: no catching butterflies, no shaking trees or throwing objects, don't enter overwintering valleys without permission (some are private land), slow down when driving through the valley. Rainy/overcast days mean little activity.

items.title: Butterfly Festival Market (Dec 5–6)
items.hours: Sat Dec 5 – Sun Dec 6 2026, 10:00–16:00 (2nd of 5 sessions; this one at the Purple Butterfly Ecological Park).
items.cost: Free; DIY is free with on-site sign-up.
highlights: Programme: 09:55 host intro · 10:00–11:00 DIY part 1 · 11:00–12:00 singers part 1 · 12:00–14:00 music/break · 14:00–15:00 DIY part 2 · 15:00–16:00 singers part 2.
Rukai-community 護蝶市集 with local culture, food and crafts; Dec 5–6 DIY is a 陶壺皮雕 (pottery-pot leather-carving) keychain.
tips: Arriving ~10:00 puts you in the DIY slot; the first singers start at 11:00 — after your planned 10:25 departure.
DIY (if anyone wants it): 30 places per session, register at the market service desk 30 min before the session.
items.watch: Later sessions (Jan 16–17 Dream Mall, Feb/Mar Aozihdi Forest Park) are in the city, not Maolin — Dec 5–6 is the last Maolin date this season.

items.title: Drive to Qishan
items.getThere: Charter car to Qishan Old Street; the old street runs along 中山路, 復興街 and 華中街 and starts at Qishan Station (中山路1號).
tips: Drop at Qishan Station/old street rather than at the temple — streets around 旗山天后宮 are likely to be crowded on procession day.

items.title: 2026 Qilu Tongfu Mazu Procession — Qishan
items.hours: Sun Dec 6 2026; Kaohsiung Travel lists timing 'per organiser's latest announcement'.
highlights: Official name 2026旗鹿同福 聖母巡安; organisers 鹿港天后宮 and 旗山天后宮. Lukang Mazu travels from Changhua to Qishan Tianhou Temple for a joint double-Mazu procession.
Crawling under the palanquin (躦轎腳) for blessings is opened at specific locations; those locations/times are announced by the temple.
Qishan Tianhou Temple itself: completed 1824, a Kaohsiung municipal heritage site known for its imperially-honoured Tiger General (金虎將軍).
tips: The temple says it posted the joint route on its Facebook page on Nov 3, warning times may run early or late with crowds and rituals — get the route image before Dec 6 (FB requires login).
items.watch: Expect heavy crowds and road control around the temple; do not touch the palanquin or sacred objects.

sources.label: Search snippet of 旗山天后宮 FB route post (Nov 3)

items.title: Driver Back to Kaohsiung (or Stay in Qishan)
items.getThere: Have the driver drop you by Kaohsiung Arena; if you come by MRT instead, Red Line to 巨蛋 (R14) Exit 1.
tips: Ruifeng opens at 17:00 — arriving 17:15–18:00 is right as stalls start up.

items.title: Ruifeng Night Market — Backup Dinner & Games
items.hours: 17:00–00:00; closed Mondays and Wednesdays — open Sunday Dec 6.
highlights: Near the Arena shopping district; over a thousand stalls laid out in an L-shaped, managed grid.
Mix of decades-old classic snacks, international stalls and newer creative dishes and drinks; Kaohsiung markets keep old-style games such as ring toss and balloon shooting.

items.title: Kaohsiung Music Center → Love River
items.hours: KMC outdoor areas open; indoor venues only for events
items.getThere: Light Rail: C10 光榮碼頭 for the Coral Reef / Whale Embankment, C11 真愛碼頭 for the Wave Tower (音浪塔), C12 駁二大義 for LIVE WAREHOUSE. KMC address 真愛路1號.
highlights: Walk the KMC waterfront (Wave Tower, Coral Reef, Whale Embankment), then follow the Love River north-east.
Love River night lights run from 愛河之心 and 光之塔 down to 真愛碼頭.
Gondola rides board at 河東路 × 民生路; round trip about 25 min, passing under 五福橋 (zodiac lights).
tips: KMC has rentable lockers (40 small 32.5×40.4 cm, 4 medium, 2 large).
Riverside paths have cafés and, on weekends, food-truck markets.
items.watch: Gondola fares/schedules aren't published on the tourism page — ask at the dock.

items.title: Liuhe / Formosa Boulevard Late Pass
items.getThere: Red Line R14 巨蛋 → R10 美麗島 (4 stops). Exits 1 and 11 are signed for 六合觀光夜市.
highlights: Dome of Light (光之穹頂): Narcissus Quagliata's glass artwork, described as the world's largest glass mosaic work, inside the Red/Orange interchange station.
Liuhe dates from the 1950s; Liuhe 2nd Rd is pedestrianised at night. Signature items lean seafood (seafood congee, salt-steamed shrimp, mullet gizzard).
tips: Treat Liuhe as dessert or one snack, as planned; a seafood signature works as that snack.
Station has 11 exits — follow signs for Exit 1 or 11 to avoid surfacing on the wrong side of Zhongshan Rd.

items.title: Back to the Hotel
items.getThere: Red Line from 美麗島 (R10) one stop north (toward 岡山車站) to 高雄車站 (R11). Last train toward 岡山車站 from 美麗島: 24:21 (all days).
